headline: no wallets over threshold
disclaimer: This is NOT a manipulation report. Repeated testing found no evidence that anyone moves the underlying; the settlement price is BTC, and a 5-min window flips on ~3bp of ordinary noise. Wallets listed here are profitable traders, most plausibly arbitraging a faster BTC feed against slow makers -- legal and unremarkable. 'leaders' are scored on the markets we sampled; only 'audited' entries are graded on the wallet's own full order flow and should be trusted. See README.
